reviews.title: They run forever
reviews.comment: I use 2 for my movie vault. I've had too much trouble with spinning disks that wear out. These are solid and haven't lost even 1 yet. Plus they spin down on their own to save motor and power. Spin up almost instantly. Wouldn't even know it had been spun down. These should last a good decade.

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.comment: Great for small game storage and  backing large workshop/mod files and or storing mod folders for games like Sims. Use it for Unity projects too and runs swell. Its still a spinner/magnetic spinner drive so not at SSD level for streaming resources and etc but works well for game installs that dont require an ssd.

reviews.title: Good drive, nothing else to say
reviews.comment: For the price (not including the shipping tax) this is a really good drive! It was packed nicely, and it is very compatible, not taking a lot of space on your desk. I do, however, have some minor issues regarding some of the games - it takes longer, much longer to start up some. For example, it takes nearly 5 minutes to start up PUBG when it used to take much less on my main drive. Overall, a REALLY neat drive
